suite.message: You find a flight log and half a bagel. It's not even stale.
MSG     : STORM ACTIVITY AHEAD          DEVIATE HDG 290DEG --- ATC NO_RESPONSE
"...and it is indeed the case that, should these pushable crates be shot thrice in rapid succession with a firearm, they will return to their original place."
ALERT: SEVERE WX IN PATH. AUTOPILOT: LNAV

Captain's log: Nov. 8 entry: "Boss says we've got almost everything we needed from this place. I wonder what he plans to do after that; he doesn't tell me much. As a POW I'm used to that, but it still makes me uneasy..."

Captain's log: Oct. 29 entry: "55 KT (headwind), ALT 6600. Looks to be smooth sailing. Whoever used to pilot this thing ran a tight ship. Not sure why there's a step-stool at the cockpit. I'm an Ooplo and even I don't need one of those..."

Captain's log: Nov. 12 entry: "We are headed straight for severe storm. Half the crew made a mad dash for the escape pods. Boss threw a fit and kicked the first mate overboard, pioneer style. This is my last entry... I'm sorry to the crew who were left behind."
